title: Spider
description: A spider walks over the hills toward wherever you point. Its legs are FABRIK chains and its body rides on springs, both solved with pmndrs/math on the CPU. The hills are fractal Perlin noise generated on the GPU, and a single readback lets the feet land on exactly the triangles you see.
line: A spider walking over GPU-made hills toward wherever you point.
hint: point at the ground · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
